body:
## Summary

Adds `superclaude init-lite --context-optimized` — a safe, read-only audit of project-local SuperClaude context surfaces (`CLAUDE.md`, `.mcp.json`, `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/commands/**`, `.claude/skills/**`, `.claude/agents/*`) that estimates context weight deterministically (`ceil(bytes / 4)`) and writes a non-destructive context-audit report. Existing context inputs are never mutated; an opt-in advisory scaffold under `.dev/superclaude/` is available behind `--scaffold`.

Cherry-picked onto a clean `feat/init-lite` branch (off `origin/master`) so the feature lands as a single, reviewable unit rather than riding on the `docs/octocode-integration-investigation-backlog` branch.

## What's included

- `cli/init_lite.py` (new) — mechanical context-weight audit; registered as `superclaude init-lite`
- `cli/main.py`, `cli/install_skills.py` — command registration + skill install wiring
- `commands/init-lite.md` (new) — `/sc:init-lite` command surface
- `skills/sc-init-lite-protocol/SKILL.md` (new) — orchestration, report schema, safety gating
- Tests: `tests/cli/test_init_lite.py` (new), `tests/cli/test_cli_registration.py`, `tests/unit/test_cli_install.py`
- Task archive: `TASK-RF-20260525-194356` promoted `to-do/ → done/`

## Verification

- `uv run pytest tests/cli/test_init_lite.py tests/cli/test_cli_registration.py tests/unit/test_cli_install.py` → 62 passed
- `superclaude --help` registers both `init-lite` and `recommend` (additive cherry-pick conflict in `main.py` resolved by keeping both deferred registrations)
- Previously validated by `/sc:reflect` (see `REPORT.md` in the originating task)

## Safety invariants

- Read-only over all existing context inputs under every flag combination
- Writes only under `.dev/superclaude/` (or an explicit `--output`); `--dry-run` writes nothing
- Never overwrites marker-less files unless `--force` and the target is init-lite-owned under `.dev/superclaude/`
title: feat(cli): add superclaude init-lite --context-optimized
